page.overview:
Who is Achilles?

Achilles is a hero from Greek mythology cited in some Arthurian texts — part of Arthurian legend.

He is the son of the sea-nymph Thetis and King Peleus, who in not to be confused with the Arthurian Pelleas or King Pelleus. Achilles fights in the Trojan war.

More can be learned about him here or here.
